title: Aligned Design Choices docs with the implemented engine contracts
points: The Design Choices section now explains the actual served corpus, router ask fields, lane table contracts, narrative BM25 shaping tools, curated numeric views, model_build compute path, and regression eval suites.
The diagrams keep the same approachable style but now label concrete surfaces such as filing pages, PSX notices, valuation_inputs, source IDs, coverage fields, and focused eval checks.
The evals language now describes focused regression/model/sample checks instead of implying a generic gold-set gate.
